notes.title: Steam Deck Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]I LOVE FIXING BUGS![/h1]
Santa got me a Steam Deck and it's pretty cool, but you know what's not cool? Unity's video player. The thing didn't work at all while playing hangover on the deck. All assets that used mp4 files were all whacked out and stuff, so I rushed to work on a patch. I found out [strike]in a Reddit post[/strike] all by myself that the shit wasn't being encoded or something tbh I already forgot what the problem was but it's fixed now.

Also, I did something else:

[h1]official Steaminput controls!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!![/h1]

If you're playing on the steam deck, I made a controller preset to assist you in your operations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159243/5d024aef275ee3ed2a87313aaddab60989ab86dc.png[/img].
I think I made it public but its not showing up when I search for it, this stuff is all new to me as I'm really dumb and stupid and not very smart and am pretty dumb.

If you notice any issues that have come from this patch, or notice issues in the Steam Deck version that I didn't notice, reach out to me on discord.
